summary: Nora's public site now tells search engines and AI answer engines what it is: a sitemap, structured data on both home pages, an llms.txt and page titles that say she is an AI.
details: Both home pages carry a schema.org graph (the site, the page, Nora as an AI agent, and who built her) and name each other as og:locale alternates.
/sitemap.xml lists the two home pages with their language alternates, and robots.txt points to it.
/llms.txt gives a model reading the site the page's own claims as plain Markdown, generated from the same copy, so it cannot drift from the page.
robots.txt no longer lets crawlers into the portal's signed-in pages under /en/, as it already did for /zh-Hant/.
limitations: Cloudflare blocks AI training crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot and others) for the whole zone; AI search and answer agents such as OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, Claude-SearchBot and PerplexityBot are let through.
